Chapter 7 tells two stories at once

NOWCamp Green Lake: Stanley digs his first hole
LONG AGOLatvia: Stanley's great-great-grandfather, Elya

Who's who in Latvia?

Elya Yelnats

15 years old. Stanley's great-great-grandfather.

Myra Menke

14, very beautiful. Elya loves her.

Igor Barkov

57, a pig farmer. Also wants to marry Myra.

Madame Zeroni

Old and wise. Elya's friend. Has only one foot.

Signal: when the story jumps between NOW and LONG AGO, put a hand on your head.

WRITEfull sentences in your notebookSet A: the deal and the curse
A1What did Madame Zeroni tell Elya to do with the piglet every day?
Every day he had to carry ___, let it ___ and ___ .
Every day he had to carry the piglet up the mountain, let it drink from the stream and sing to it.
A2What did Elya promise to do for Madame Zeroni?
He promised to carry ___, let her ___ and ___ .
The same three words: carry, drink, sing.
He promised to carry her up the mountain, let her drink from the stream and sing the song to her.
A3Why did the two pigs weigh exactly the same?
They weighed the same because Elya ___ instead of ___ .
What did he do on the morning of Myra's birthday?
They weighed the same because Elya took a bath instead of carrying his pig up the mountain one last time.
A4Why did Madame Zeroni curse Elya?
She cursed him because he broke his ___: he went to ___ and never ___ .
What did he forget when the ship left the harbour?
She cursed him because he broke his promise: he went to America and never carried her up the mountain to drink from the stream and hear the song.
A4 matters: it is a real test-style question.
WRITEfull sentences in your notebookSet B: after the curse
B1Was Elya really a "pig-stealing" great-great-grandfather? Back it up.
No, he did not steal the pig. We know this because Madame Zeroni said "___".
What did she say when she gave him the runt?
No, he did not steal the pig. We know this because Madame Zeroni gave him the runt and said "You may have him."
B2How does bad luck follow Elya in America? Give one example.
Bad luck follows him because ... For example, ...
Bad luck follows him because he is always in the wrong place at the wrong time. For example, his barn is struck by lightning three times.
B3Why did Sarah name the baby Stanley?
She named him Stanley because ...
She named him Stanley because "Stanley" is "Yelnats" spelled backwards.
Extension (early finishers): was Myra's head really "as empty as a flowerpot"? Back it up.
